finalText:
**`Redis` died at 02:14 and took the whole service down.**

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:08 | cache miss storm, every read hits the store |
| 02:14:10 | store overloads, 5s `TimeoutError` floods start |
| 02:15:26 → 02:31:26 | 13 reconnect tries, all refused |
| 02:31:24 | queue depth 568, cap 500 |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory, exit 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Onset is [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182). Last good request was 02:14:03.

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused. Reconnect never backed off or shed load. Heads up, the log is dated 2026-07-04, not last night.
